contracts.target_band_zero: central VWAP with mandatory TP, never target off
contracts.level_columns: raw entry band prices for SL, raw target band prices for TP; absolute quantization and symbol point conversion in existing Backtester before lot
contracts.override_precedence: Explicit target_points uses fill; target_r uses fill and initial risk. Explicit stop_points replaces initial band+offset without duplicating offset.
contracts.timestamp_convention: Strictly increasing unique valid naive timestamps supplied in declared server calendar; no epoch/tz/DST inference, sorting, gap repair or auction claim
contracts.auto_selection: One complete series for each known fixed prefix; has_real persists across dates. Two independent daily accumulators; no mixed ticks/real or future selection. Native rolling1500 may return to ticks when old real leaves window.
contracts.anchor: Initial mid-day prefix unavailable until next observed date; midnight or observed transition starts approximation at first available bar
contracts.invalidity: Invalid HLC/selected volume or nonfinite/sentinel aggregation poisons selected date until observed transition; valid zero volume carries prior mean
